io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.description: Local read-only Corvint context and repository evidence server.
io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.name: corvint-mcp

tools.name: corvint.graph.imports
tools.description: Read pinned whole-tree file import edges and language uncertainties as graph-imports/1 JSONL. Required: revision (full commit ID). Optional kinds: comma-separated import,type-import,angular-template,angular-style,ruby-constant (filters edges only). Pages preserve CLI byte order; repeat with nextOffset and identical revision/kinds until done. No total result cap. Syntax and single-candidate Zeitwerk evidence only; non-literal or ambiguous references, selectors and string-keyed DI are uncertain. Example: {revision: FULL_COMMIT, offset: 0}.

tools.name: corvint.help
tools.description: Return the task-indexed agent guide exactly as `corvint help guide` prints it (the default), one command's catalog entry exactly as `corvint help --json COMMAND` prints it (command NAME, under 5 KB), or with topic catalog the full command catalog (corvint-capability-catalog/0, about 180 KB) exactly as `corvint help --json` prints it. Reads only the binary, never the repository.

tools.name: corvint.impact
tools.description: Compile revision-bound impact evidence without source bodies. Capabilities: Go (.go): path, package imports; Ruby (.rb): path, markers, advisory autoload constant references, reverse imports unknown; JavaScript (.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs) and TypeScript (.ts/.tsx): path, literal relative/profile/tsconfig-alias imports, unresolved bare imports unknown. Non-Go paths name experimental non-go-syntax-v0. Dynamic dispatch and test closure remain unknown. The receipt equals CLI corvint impact with the syntax profile for the same paths, revision and limit; the CLI admits more suffixes and --base (corvint impact --capabilities). MCP accepts paths only.

tools.name: corvint.query
tools.description: Compile the narrow project-operations authority-start receipt (limit is fixed at one).

tools.name: corvint.status
tools.description: Observe Git commit, tree, worktree state, and a privacy-preserving dirty-path digest. Gitlinks bind commit IDs; nested submodule contents are outside coverage.
